before.claim_zh: 活动后果可改变后继形成与选择条件，贡献变体不必获益。重构、发育与聚合区分遗传群体和运输集合；细菌回复实验接通遗传切换与周期完成。谱系预测保留总体优势及局部失败。新增原始实证支持呼吸形成氧梯度并改变后续选择；结构形成史须接入发育迁移，常规解释获完整信用。 原始延时研究进一步记录界面小筏形成、下落和再形成；酸碱条件改变空间组织，须与持续膜结构和实际后代分别对应。 此前比较方向提出独立机制约束下的跨条件接续，以及重构和选择关系自身的改变。 新的24小时形成实测与常规模型进一步接通建立条件和留存占比；较低离散的优势取决于相对生长，反例保留。 已完成的演化组织说明进一步接通实际取样、继承发育状态与跨转移重建；组织改变后续取样结果，真实供给及后续修订均保留。 原始显微数据现核对真实尺度及逐位置拍摄时钟，混合培养两段采集的位置配置可接续；成像对应与培养物身份仍分别论证。 直接同等网络比较现证明重构机制具有精确的常规实现，包含依当前状态选择及失败行动。 Ren现明确要求聚焦理论：复用形成、重构、更新器及目的修订成果，比较其独立前提与额外解释，当时选定具体联结论学习结果的恢复。 预先固定视野的91帧现接成实测发育史；增长后的局部消失与轨迹的边界删失分别保留，观察结束不独自说明结构丧失。 新理论连接把后继重建能力接到完整回返路径的选择阈值及繁殖代价；直接外形延续可下降，第一代相同产出仍可掩盖相反的增长条件。 现已恢复单步Hebb方向，有限循环发育的后果响应由规律导出；tanh符号相容条件保持方向，并支持有限关系改变，反馈和选择关系改变可反转局部增益。 有限组装程序现从实际消耗及成功停止共同推出P列产出和重建比例；成功概率不同于后继比例，额外尝试可提高成功却消除增长优势。既有类型的增长因子接入相邻规则入侵条件。 新的共同历史由逐项非线性选择推出留存关系：同一网络从不完整线索重现两种格局，持续偏向一方造成旧格局失去重现能力，继续修订又能恢复；当前选择改善不保证保留旧能力。 实际传递组成与保留接触机会现导出局部成功率，后继自行重建成键；同一亲代、同平均成键率和接触消耗仍可因后继间机会分布不同而产生不同重建。不同种类传播体的响应不能无条件压成同一个回返系数。 后续同史构造把反复干扰造成的实际反应失败接到更新器维持与替换：由原生发育算出回报差别，保留旧关系与剩余支持，新规则实际改变后续更新并取得维持所需支持。 三阶段接续现证明条件性的有限周期回返，平衡混合时可用发育后响应的均值合并；成熟亲代的准备规律仍须实现。 组成生成与付费安放现实现指定亲代准备：同类生成使原先接触重建优势倒转，互补生成又改变排序；失败保留未用组成和支持，未完成指定返回不等于死亡。 参考接触现取得未知仿射通道的实际读数，形成的局部比较与抑制连接推出响应式更新，并在保留网络及支持记录中运行；校准后的通道变化可造成实际误报并阻止修复。
before.claim_en: Consequences can change successor formation and selection without guaranteeing contributor advantage. Reconstruction, development and aggregation distinguish inherited clusters from transport groups; bacterial reversion links switching to cycle completion. Lineage forecasts retain aggregate gains and local failures. Primary evidence now links respiration-generated oxygen gradients to changed selection; structural development must enter transferable prediction. Conventional explanation receives full credit. Original time-lapse research adds recurring surface rafts and pH-sensitive spatial organization, requiring separate correspondences for persistent mat structure and actual descendants. Earlier comparative work proposed continuation across conditions constrained by independent mechanisms, followed by changes in reconstruction and selection relations. New 24-hour observations and a conventional model connect establishment to retained representation; lower dispersal gains only under the relative-growth condition, with an adverse contrast preserved. The completed evolutionary-organization account now connects actual sampling, inherited developmental state and reconstruction across transfers; formed organization changes later sampling, with actual provision and subsequent revision retained. Original microscopy now supplies checked scale and position-specific capture times, with continued position configuration across two rescue acquisitions; imaging correspondence and culture identity remain distinct. A direct matched-network comparison now establishes an exact conventional realization of the reconstruction mechanism, including shared state-dependent selectors and failed actions. Ren now directs a theoretical focus: reuse formation, reconstruction, updater and goal-revision results, compare their independent premises and added explanation, and selected recovery of a specific connectionist learning result. A predefined field now has a measured 91-frame developmental history; local disappearance after growth is distinguished from boundary censoring, so an observation ending does not alone establish structural loss. A new theoretical connection gives a full-cycle selection threshold and reproductive cost ceiling for inherited reconstruction; direct resemblance can fall, and identical first-generation outputs can conceal opposite growth conditions. The single-step Hebbian direction is now recovered. Finite recurrent sensitivity follows from the developmental law; a sign-compatible tanh regime preserves the direction through finite changes, while feedback and changed selective relations can reverse local gains. A finite assembly programme now derives P-column production and reconstruction jointly from paid attempts and stopping. Success probability differs from the descendant fraction, and added attempts can improve success while removing growth advantage. The resident factor enters an adjacent-rule invasion condition. A new common history derives retained relations from coordinate-wise nonlinear selection: the same network recalls two patterns from incomplete cues, continued emphasis on one destroys old recall, and further revision restores it. Current-score improvement does not guarantee preservation of an earlier capacity. Actual transmitted components and retained contact slots now determine local success, with each successor rebuilding its own bond. The same parent, mean encounter rate and cost can yield different reconstruction because opportunities are distributed differently across successors. Distinct seed responses cannot unconditionally be collapsed to one return coefficient. A subsequent common history connects actual response failures from repeated interference to updater maintenance and replacement: native development determines return differences, old relationships and remaining support persist, and the new rule governs later updates and earns renewal. A three-stage continuation proves conditional finite-cycle return and permits aggregation by the mean developed response under a balanced mixture; common mature-parent preparation still requires realization. Component production and paid routing now realize preparation of the specified parent: same-type production reverses the contact reconstruction ranking, while complementary production changes it again. Failed preparation retains components and work; missing the specified return does not establish death. Reference contacts now acquire actual readings of unknown affine channels. Formed local comparisons and inhibition derive responsive updating and operate in the retained network/support history; channel changes after calibration can cause false success and suppress repair.

The 54 videos/18 technical replicates, 33/190 sensitivity, 3,808 records/3,600 links, 42/72 versus 7/72, 3,424 forecasts and 139-cohort/485-row checks retain their scopes. Eight growth and two competition summaries cannot become cycle probabilities. Initial absence versus later loss, joint calibration, broad comparison and support renewal remain open. Four original movies are preserved and 44 selected-frame correspondences pass; frames are not replicates. Exact genotype attribution, acquisition timing and linked descendants remain incomplete; no cycle probability is fitted. The new direction assessment is complete; ecological scaffolding, endogenization and evolutionary connectionism are strong comparators. Superiority is unestablished, with no new forecast or theorem. New checks cover 45 cultures/11 dated cohorts, preserving a 784-versus-769 count ambiguity and numerical capacity failure; event integration is an explicit model adaptation. The focused account is complete at the selected scope: 20 new Lean theorems / 44 new declaration audits / 113 closure audits. Finite-history inheritance and reconstruction do not establish invasion stability or indefinite renewal; primary interventions and strong comparators are assessed, while broad superiority remains unestablished. New checks cover 4,383 directory entries, 388 timestamps, 114 first/last image records and two complete pixel fields; scene offsets reach 225.89 seconds and the restart gap is 337.39 seconds. Treatment/endpoint identity, interior trajectories and six-day descendants remain unjoined; no new theorem. Eleven new Lean theorems / 24 new audits and 34,768 executed comparisons establish equivalence under matched laws, not Watson-model replication or an empirical win. The direct comparison is closed; independently constrained joint empirical prediction remains open. The theoretical integration and author counterreview are complete, with no new theorem. Internal premise reduction is distinct from demonstrated comparative economy; the ethical extension discloses G0 and further commitments. Empirical calibration is not this task’s theoretical completion gate; broad superiority remains unestablished. New checks cover 91 image subblocks and 23,855,104 crop pixels, preserving detection and movement sensitivity. Four longest assigned tracks include local-loss candidates and a still-visible boundary object; no collapse rate, descendant join or new theorem is asserted. Twenty-eight new Lean theorems / forty audits cover finite-history bounds and conditional identification. Mesoscopic production, routing and transmission remain supplied, not derived from cell events. Conventional life-cycle models retain full credit; the then-pending connectionist recovery is addressed below, while broad superiority remains open. Twenty-nine new Lean theorems / 41 declaration audits pass under explicit developmental and selection laws. Finite adverse cases and supplied native laws, initial states and mutation/transmission premises remain. The named directional recovery is complete; memory, interference and continued revision across patterns were its selected continuation. No new empirical prediction or broad novelty is claimed. Thirty-seven new Lean theorems / fifty-seven audits pass, with 166 closure audits. The finite programme connection is complete; trial success, copying, mature output and renewal remain supplied. A separate-averages approximation has an opposite growth sign; the equally informed conventional mechanism agrees. No new empirical result or broad superiority is claimed. The developmental-memory connection now has 28 new Lean theorems / 44 new declaration audits, with 41 inherited audits separately rebuilt; ambiguous-cue failure is preserved. Scope is sign recall with self-interactions and full-decay tanh. Adapted training profiles, proposals, step size, schedule and readout horizons remain explicit. The bounded multi-pattern memory connection is complete; interference consequences entering update-rule formation or revision were its selected continuation. Capacity, amplitude convergence, biological applicability and full-theory completion are not claimed. The contact reconstruction connection adds 30 Lean theorems / 57 new audits, with 223 closure audits. It replaces the independent success rate and parental bond flag in this construction without reusing the old offspring formula. Compatibility, uniform replacement sampling, partition formation and mature-stage provision remain explicit. A one-cycle comparison is not invasion; partition formation/cost and a population interface retaining seed distinctions are next. Strong spatial models retain full credit. Consequence-dependent updater replacement adds 36 Lean theorems / 57 new audits, with 85 inherited audits separately rebuilt. One-step full-profile readout, two available rules, faithful success, construction and support laws remain explicit. Failed old-rule replacement, no gain on unchanged tasks, extra cost, false reports and source exhaustion are preserved. This finite replacement connection is complete; construction of the responsive rule and reliable access from local relations was its selected continuation, with no population-frequency, ethical-necessity or broad-superiority claim. Material maturation adds 28 Lean theorems / 44 new audits, with 267 closure audits. The finite preparation connection is complete; return follows from actual composition-dependent growth and routing. Production laws, routing recipe/capabilities, slot geometry, partition formation and supplies remain explicit. Primary comparison is not replication or superiority. Formation, inheritance and revision of reproductive recipes and partitions are next; completed material preparation is reused. Acquired discrimination and updater construction add 30 Lean theorems / 59 new audits, with 142 inherited audits separately rebuilt. Stable nonzero affine channels, bound references, component laws, an assembly plan and ten extra construction units/four parts at entrance remain explicit. Missing contact, constant channels, underfunding and altered transfer are preserved. This local correspondence is complete; maintaining reference-to-use correspondence through change is next. Generic calibration/formation results are not reopened; no population, ethical or broad-superiority conclusion follows.

after.claim_zh: 活动后果可改变后继形成与选择条件，贡献变体不必获益。重构、发育与聚合区分遗传群体和运输集合；细菌回复实验接通遗传切换与周期完成。谱系预测保留总体优势及局部失败。新增原始实证支持呼吸形成氧梯度并改变后续选择；结构形成史须接入发育迁移，常规解释获完整信用。 原始延时研究进一步记录界面小筏形成、下落和再形成；酸碱条件改变空间组织，须与持续膜结构和实际后代分别对应。 此前比较方向提出独立机制约束下的跨条件接续，以及重构和选择关系自身的改变。 新的24小时形成实测与常规模型进一步接通建立条件和留存占比；较低离散的优势取决于相对生长，反例保留。 已完成的演化组织说明进一步接通实际取样、继承发育状态与跨转移重建；组织改变后续取样结果，真实供给及后续修订均保留。 原始显微数据现核对真实尺度及逐位置拍摄时钟，混合培养两段采集的位置配置可接续；成像对应与培养物身份仍分别论证。 直接同等网络比较现证明重构机制具有精确的常规实现，包含依当前状态选择及失败行动。 Ren现明确要求聚焦理论：复用形成、重构、更新器及目的修订成果，比较其独立前提与额外解释，当时选定具体联结论学习结果的恢复。 预先固定视野的91帧现接成实测发育史；增长后的局部消失与轨迹的边界删失分别保留，观察结束不独自说明结构丧失。 新理论连接把后继重建能力接到完整回返路径的选择阈值及繁殖代价；直接外形延续可下降，第一代相同产出仍可掩盖相反的增长条件。 现已恢复单步Hebb方向，有限循环发育的后果响应由规律导出；tanh符号相容条件保持方向，并支持有限关系改变，反馈和选择关系改变可反转局部增益。 有限组装程序现从实际消耗及成功停止共同推出P列产出和重建比例；成功概率不同于后继比例，额外尝试可提高成功却消除增长优势。既有类型的增长因子接入相邻规则入侵条件。 新的共同历史由逐项非线性选择推出留存关系：同一网络从不完整线索重现两种格局，持续偏向一方造成旧格局失去重现能力，继续修订又能恢复；当前选择改善不保证保留旧能力。 实际传递组成与保留接触机会现导出局部成功率，后继自行重建成键；同一亲代、同平均成键率和接触消耗仍可因后继间机会分布不同而产生不同重建。不同种类传播体的响应不能无条件压成同一个回返系数。 后续同史构造把反复干扰造成的实际反应失败接到更新器维持与替换：由原生发育算出回报差别，保留旧关系与剩余支持，新规则实际改变后续更新并取得维持所需支持。 三阶段接续现证明条件性的有限周期回返，平衡混合时可用发育后响应的均值合并；成熟亲代的准备规律仍须实现。 组成生成与付费安放现实现指定亲代准备：同类生成使原先接触重建优势倒转，互补生成又改变排序；失败保留未用组成和支持，未完成指定返回不等于死亡。 参考接触现取得未知仿射通道的实际读数，形成的局部比较与抑制连接推出响应式更新，并在保留网络及支持记录中运行；校准后的通道变化可造成实际误报并阻止修复。 新参考比较现决定保留或修订已取得的读数，并实际恢复原网络更新；有限工作段之间可以改变通道。仿射通道零点相同、增益同向恰好保留全部符号判断，参数变化不独自等于能力丧失。
after.claim_en: Consequences can change successor formation and selection without guaranteeing contributor advantage. Reconstruction, development and aggregation distinguish inherited clusters from transport groups; bacterial reversion links switching to cycle completion. Lineage forecasts retain aggregate gains and local failures. Primary evidence now links respiration-generated oxygen gradients to changed selection; structural development must enter transferable prediction. Conventional explanation receives full credit. Original time-lapse research adds recurring surface rafts and pH-sensitive spatial organization, requiring separate correspondences for persistent mat structure and actual descendants. Earlier comparative work proposed continuation across conditions constrained by independent mechanisms, followed by changes in reconstruction and selection relations. New 24-hour observations and a conventional model connect establishment to retained representation; lower dispersal gains only under the relative-growth condition, with an adverse contrast preserved. The completed evolutionary-organization account now connects actual sampling, inherited developmental state and reconstruction across transfers; formed organization changes later sampling, with actual provision and subsequent revision retained. Original microscopy now supplies checked scale and position-specific capture times, with continued position configuration across two rescue acquisitions; imaging correspondence and culture identity remain distinct. A direct matched-network comparison now establishes an exact conventional realization of the reconstruction mechanism, including shared state-dependent selectors and failed actions. Ren now directs a theoretical focus: reuse formation, reconstruction, updater and goal-revision results, compare their independent premises and added explanation, and selected recovery of a specific connectionist learning result. A predefined field now has a measured 91-frame developmental history; local disappearance after growth is distinguished from boundary censoring, so an observation ending does not alone establish structural loss. A new theoretical connection gives a full-cycle selection threshold and reproductive cost ceiling for inherited reconstruction; direct resemblance can fall, and identical first-generation outputs can conceal opposite growth conditions. The single-step Hebbian direction is now recovered. Finite recurrent sensitivity follows from the developmental law; a sign-compatible tanh regime preserves the direction through finite changes, while feedback and changed selective relations can reverse local gains. A finite assembly programme now derives P-column production and reconstruction jointly from paid attempts and stopping. Success probability differs from the descendant fraction, and added attempts can improve success while removing growth advantage. The resident factor enters an adjacent-rule invasion condition. A new common history derives retained relations from coordinate-wise nonlinear selection: the same network recalls two patterns from incomplete cues, continued emphasis on one destroys old recall, and further revision restores it. Current-score improvement does not guarantee preservation of an earlier capacity. Actual transmitted components and retained contact slots now determine local success, with each successor rebuilding its own bond. The same parent, mean encounter rate and cost can yield different reconstruction because opportunities are distributed differently across successors. Distinct seed responses cannot unconditionally be collapsed to one return coefficient. A subsequent common history connects actual response failures from repeated interference to updater maintenance and replacement: native development determines return differences, old relationships and remaining support persist, and the new rule governs later updates and earns renewal. A three-stage continuation proves conditional finite-cycle return and permits aggregation by the mean developed response under a balanced mixture; common mature-parent preparation still requires realization. Component production and paid routing now realize preparation of the specified parent: same-type production reverses the contact reconstruction ranking, while complementary production changes it again. Failed preparation retains components and work; missing the specified return does not establish death. Reference contacts now acquire actual readings of unknown affine channels. Formed local comparisons and inhibition derive responsive updating and operate in the retained network/support history; channel changes after calibration can cause false success and suppress repair. Fresh reference comparison now determines retention or revision of acquired readings and restores native updating across finite blocks with changed channels. Equal zero and same gain orientation exactly preserve the all-input affine sign interface; parameter change alone does not establish lost capacity.
after.scope_zh: 保留16/26、19/41、7/13及6/6定理/审计与反例；本轮新增7项局部定理／11项审计。54段视频/18项技术重复、33/190敏感性、3,808记录/3,600联系及42/72对7/72保持范围；3,424项预测及139分组/485行核验保留。新核对八项生长及两项竞争摘要，不能转作周期概率。初始未形成与后来失效须区分；联合校准、广泛比较与支持更新仍开放。 新保存四份影片，44帧像素对应核验通过；帧数不是重复。基因标签、拍摄时钟及后代联系未齐，未拟合周期概率。 新方向评估已完成，须与生态支架、内生化及演化联结论等强对手比较；优越性未获确立，无新预测或定理。 新核对45项培养物／11个日期组，保留784对769数量歧义与数值容量失败；事件求解只作显式模型适配。 聚焦说明现按用户选定范围完成：20项新 Lean 定理／44项新声明审计／113项闭包审计。有限历史继承及重建不等于入侵稳定性或无限更新；原始干预和强比较已评估，广泛优越性仍未成立。 新核对4,383项目录、388项时间戳、114项首末图像记录及两幅完整像素场；位置时差最大225.89秒，重启间隔337.39秒。处理／终点身份、内部轨迹及六日后代仍未接齐，无新定理。 新增11项 Lean 定理／24项审计及34,768项执行，结论是同等法则下等价，非 Watson 模型复现或经验胜出。直接比较已关合，独立约束的联合经验预测仍开放。 理论整合与作者反审已完成，无新定理；局部前提消解不等于已证比较经济性，伦理延展明示G0及附加承诺。经验校准不作本轮理论完成门槛；广泛优越性仍未证。 新核对91项图像子块及23,855,104个裁剪像素；三种检测阈值与三种移动界限的敏感性保留。四条最长分配轨迹含局部骤失候选及仍可见的边界对象；不拟合坍塌率，不补造后代连接，无新定理。 新增28项 Lean 定理／40项审计，含有限历史界及条件识别；中观产出、路由及传递仍给定，未由细胞事件导出。常规生命周期模型获完整信用，当时的联结论学习恢复待办现由后续成果接通，广泛优越性仍开放。 新增29项Lean定理／41项声明审计通过，使用明示的发育与选择规律；保留有限反例及原生法则、初始状态、变异传递等前提。具名方向恢复完成，当时选定多格局记忆、干扰和持续修订；无新经验预测或广泛原创性声明。 新增37项 Lean 定理／57项新审计，含166项闭包审计；有限程序连接已完成，单次成功、复制、成熟产出及更新仍给定。独立平均近似有增长符号反例，同信息的常规机制模型保持一致，无新实证或广泛优越性。 发育记忆连接现有28项新 Lean 定理／44项新声明审计，另重建41项继承审计；模糊线索失败保留。限于含自作用、完全衰减tanh的符号重现，训练初始适应、提案、步长、日程及读出视野明示。多格局记忆连接按此范围完成；当时选定干扰后果进入更新规则形成或修订，不宣告容量、幅值收敛、生物适用或全理论完成。 接触重建连接新增30项 Lean 定理／57项新审计，含223项闭包审计；替代本构造中独立成功率和亲代成键标记复制，未替代旧产出公式。兼容、均匀有放回取样、分割及成熟供给仍明示；单周期比较不冒充入侵。下一项是分割形成及成本与后继类型保留的种群连接；强空间模型获完整信用。 后果—更新器替换新增36项 Lean 定理／57项新审计，另重建85项继承审计。明示单步完整格局读出、两种可用规则、可靠成功信号、形成及支持法则；保留旧规则再次失效、同任务无优势、额外成本、误报与支持耗尽。此有限替换连接完成；当时选定可用响应规则及可靠辨别由局部关系构成的实际对应，非种群频率、伦理必然或广泛优越性结论。 材料成熟新增28项 Lean 定理／44项新审计，含267项闭包审计；有限准备连接完成，整体返回概率由实际组成生长和路由推出。生成规律、装配配方及能力、槽位几何、分割形成与供给仍给定；原典比较不冒充复现或优越性。下一项是繁殖配方和分割的形成、传递及修订，不重开已有材料准备。 辨别取得及更新构造新增30项 Lean 定理／59项新审计，另重建142项继承审计。明示稳定非零仿射通道、参考绑定、部件法则、构造计划，以及入口额外10单位构造支持与4个部件。缺接触、常数通道、支持不足和传递改变均保留。此局部对应完成；当时选定变化中的参考—使用对应，不重开一般校准或形成机制，不宣告种群、伦理或广泛优越性。 参考接续新增34项 Lean 定理／50项新审计，201项继承审计分列。实际六读数比较及有支持的提交取代正确变化警报；每段7单位是充分预算，段内共同关系、参考绑定、精确仿射类及复查日程仍明示。保留仅检查零点、六单位不足提交、常数通道、迟发变化、跨时参考和非仿射重合。此有限复查连接完成；下一项是在实际活动中保持参考—使用关系或界定其偏离，不宣告自供支持、普遍可靠或演化优越性。
